criterion: With a distinctive unmatched query entered in the GIS layer catalogue search, the query remains visible and the catalogue shows no unrelated layer entries as matches.
steps_taken: Navigated to https://o2intelligence-v4-dev.metricell.com/launcher; verified visible authenticated launcher and saved this criterion's initial PNG.
Opened GIS; verified the catalogue and recorded its original visible state before searching.
Entered TEST2-showcase-no-match-20261012 in Search layers; waited for visible 'No layers match this search.' and saved transition evidence.
Captured criterion-1-final.png with the visible query and no-match assertion; recorded current browser URL.
Cleared the query using its clear icon; verified catalogue returned and captured cleanup separately.
observedResult: Query TEST2-showcase-no-match-20261012 remained visible; catalogue displayed 'No layers match this search.' with no unrelated entries.
reason: The existing ALL Coverage Gap Candidate Areas layer showed 'Unable to load coverage gap candidate areas.' before and after testing. Its selection and the rendered basemap were observable, so catalogue search and preservation assertions could be tested. No data, layers or map settings were altered; the query was cleared.
